drafted_from: tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion's own row and test/waiting-records.test.mjs, whose run answered the value shown here
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that record:waiting-on-you:sample-signed-form really reads done for request key sample-completion." It runs tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion, which reads the same record and writes nothing.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the same waiting record a completion changed and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Use the ids and request_key a tool:finish-what-is-waiting-on-me call used.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:verify-waiting-on-me-completion and { ids, request_key }.
3. Read completed: the ids whose current record shows the completion; a different command under the same key is refused as original_command_conflict.
